attributes.action: Make SGO payments Non-means tested until 18 across all councils & LA in England
attributes.additional_details: In England SGO being non-means tested until the age of 18 is like the postcode lottery, some councils do and some don’t, knocking a lot of guardians and there family’s into financial hardship , this should be made across the board non-means tested to help all families not just some
attributes.background: All councils /LA to pay non-means tested SGO allowance to all Special Guardians of the child/children until the age of 18 years old

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition:

Fund consistent support for all Special Guardians
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/784351
